cap:info.cap:headline: Due to continuous increase of water level of River Ranganadi at N H Crossing Ranganadi in Lakhimpur district of Assam, Citizens are advised to stay away from the river. Issued in Public Interest by ASDMA.
cap:info.cap:description: River Ranganadi at N H Crossing Ranganadi in Lakhimpur district of Assam continues to flow in above normal flood situation at 9:00 am today. At 9:00 am, it was flowing at a level of 93.9 m with rising trend which is 0.48 m above its Warning Level of 93.42 m and 0.52 m below its Danger Level of 94.42 m.

cap:area.cap:areaDesc: Ranganadi, N H Crossing Ranganadi, Lakhimpur, Assam
